title: Adaptive Weighted Eval Bridge for Quantization Profiles
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: We need a lightweight, profile-aware evaluation bridge that computes a unified set of quality signals for FP8/INT8 quantized model variants and ties them directly into the calibration workflow and gating pipeline. Current eval runs live in ad-hoc scripts and separate eval clusters; teams lack a consistent metric contract (normalization, weighting, and drift thresholds) for automated rollout gating.

Goal: Implement an "Adaptive Weighted Eval Bridge" that: (1) normalizes and aggregates per-task metrics (perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy, BLEU/ROUGE, and task-specific scorers) into a composite score; (2) is aware of quantization profile metadata (quant type, per-tensor scale behavior, calibration batch distribution) and exposes per-profile deltas; (3) plugs into the calibration workflow to run pre/post calibration comparisons and emit gating decisions; (4) publishes metrics to Console dashboards and to the quality registry for rollout gating.

Key design points: use sample-based evaluation to limit compute; compute both raw and normalized metrics with a configurable weighting schedule per task; support task-level tolerances (e.g., acceptable perplexity delta, MMLU max drop); implement a small scorer SDK that accepts a profile id and returns metric vector + composite score. Must be able to run as a batch job in both hosted CI and Dedicated evaluation clusters and expose an API for ad-hoc checks from engineers.

Why this is different: Existing work focuses on per-model quant validation harnesses or scorer registries. This ticket creates a bridge that is both profile-aware and adaptive (weights adjust by task importance and sample difficulty) and integrates tightly with the calibration pipeline to power automatic gating and post-deploy regression alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Scorer SDK implements standard metric outputs: perplexity (log perplexity + tokens), MMLU-accuracy, BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, and custom task scorer hooks
Composite score computed and documented with a default weighting config; composite vs baseline delta is reported per-profile
Calibration workflow runs pre/post quantization evaluations and the bridge emits a pass/fail gating flag based on configurable thresholds
Evaluation runs produce structured artifacts (JSON metrics, diffs, sample failure cases) and upload to the Console storage path
Integration tests covering at least one FP8 and one INT8 profile with synthetic workloads are green in CI
Metrics visible in a Console dashboard and linked from the profile page (runtime-1.20)
tasks: Design metric contract and default weights (with PM input)
Implement Scorer SDK with pluggable metric adapters (perplexity, MMLU, BLEU/ROUGE, custom hooks)
Add profile metadata ingestion to evaluation job (quant type, calibration batch stats)
Implement composite score builder and tolerance rules engine
Wire evaluator to calibration pipeline: pre/post jobs and gating API
Create small Console dashboard and storage path for artifacts
Add CI integration tests and stress-run on dedicated eval cluster
Document usage and runbook for on-call teams
comments: 2025-01-18 - Asha Patel: Initial ticket created after quant QA sync. PM (Lucille) requested a single pass/fail signal for rolling out INT8 variants.
2025-01-22 - Miguel Santos: Initial design doc posted; opted for sample-based evaluation to keep cost bounded. Requested PM to confirm default task weights.
2025-01-28 - Lucille Thompson (PM): Weights agreed in design review: perplexity 30%, MMLU 40%, BLEU/ROUGE 20%, task-specific scorers 10%; requested per-customer overrides later.
2025-02-01 - Engineering: Scorer SDK prototype merged to feature branch; added baseline data generator and a small synthetic dataset for unit tests (PR #312)

2025-02-05 - QA: Ran FP8/INT8 smoke runs on dedicated eval cluster. Observed a 2.8% average MMLU drop for one INT8 profile; bridging composite score flagged profile as FAIL under current thresholds. Logged sample failures and linked artifacts.
2025-02-07 - Miguel Santos: Updated ticket with next steps: add automated post-calibration rerun and tie gating decisions to rollout service. Raising estimate for dashboard work (+2 points).
notes: Trade-offs: sample-based evaluation reduces cost but risks missing rare regressions; mitigate by selecting tail-heavy samples and scheduling full-eval nightly for critical profiles.
Performance: computing BLEU/ROUGE at scale is expensive; we compute on a subset and cache reference tokenizations per-task.
Security: metrics artifacts contain no customer PII; confirm with Security for on-prem upload flows (follow-up ticket if required).
